This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 28 and 66, values -0.0179589801 and -0.0175259449 (difference 4.330e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,557 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 4.445e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map.
